item.title: Printable Wall Art Size Calculator: Print Sizes and DPI for Etsy
item.description: Free print size and DPI calculator for Etsy printable wall art and print on demand. Enter your image's pixel size and see every frame size it prints sharp at (8x10, 11x14, 16x20, A4 and more), which aspect ratios need a crop, and the pixels each size needs. No signup.
